questions.q: What is the problem with showing the same offers to everyone?
a: It ignores what individual prospects actually want
questions.why: The overview compares it to a salesperson asking 'how can I help?'

questions.q: How should surveys begin, per lesson 1?
a: With a question about what people struggle with
questions.why: Lesson 1 suggests starting with the biggest challenge question.

questions.q: What does lesson 1 say about what people know?
a: They know what they don't want better than what they do
They know exactly what they want
questions.why: Lesson 1 says most don't know what they want, but know what they don't.

questions.q: When should you make your sales pitch, per lesson 2?
a: After you know who you're talking to
questions.why: Lesson 2 says make a hyper-relevant pitch only after learning about the prospect.

questions.q: What does the Profit Maximization Upsell do?
a: Offers another relevant item right after the first purchase
questions.why: Lesson 3 recommends presenting another offer right after purchase.
